summary: The hybrid worker's plan is now easy to review before you let it change anything.

fixes.title: The hybrid worker log lists every change
fixes.text: The worker now writes one line per group or member it would change, or changed, with the reason. The continuous sync writes a new plan only when it changes.

fixes.title: Quieter handling of nested groups
fixes.text: A group that is a member of a PIM group is still skipped, now without an error line in the worker log on every pass.
